title: LanguageCard
description: One retrieval card describing a single normalized SysML/KerML language concept. Citation-only by design: summary is an original paraphrase, never reproduced normative prose.

schema_version.description: Card schema version. Bumped only on concept split/merge or a field change. `1.1` is a v1.1 minor, strictly-additive bump for the optional `metamodel_facet` field; every `1` field is unchanged and cards without a facet omit it.

id.description: Stable concept ID: <authority>.<facet>.<slug>, exactly three lowercase dot-separated segments.

category.description: Facet tags for retrieval clustering; at least one, controlled vocabulary.

summary.description: Short, spec-faithful, original paraphrase (citation-only). Never reproduced normative prose.

aliases.description: Superseded concept IDs and raw source rule names that map to this card.

normative_rules.description: Grammar citations by rule name (resolvable via derived/xtext-rules.toml).

normative_clauses.description: Spec-clause citations resolved against the derived plaintext heading index (never raw line numbers).

normalized_grammar.description: Serialized normalized Xtext IR expression tree for syntactic concepts, or null for non-syntactic cards.

rule_dependencies.description: Flattened dependency rule names (folded structural/lexical helpers and rule/cross-ref targets).

semantic_types.description: Metamodel / ElementKind type names this concept lowers to.

validation_rules.description: Semantic-rule IDs (S0xx) and obligation IDs backing this concept.

support.description: Eight-axis support object. See support-status.schema.json for value derivation.

related_cards.description: Cross-links to related card IDs. tooling.implementation.* cards MUST list at least one normative (kerml/sysml) card.

metamodel_facet.description: Additive v1.1 field: the metamodel/SHACL view of this concept — inheritance, owned/reference properties with multiplicities, relationship endpoints (reference properties), and the applicable OSLC/SHACL shape — folded onto the ONE concept card instead of minted as a duplicate metamodel card. Absent (omitted, not null) on cards with no backing metaclass.

metaclass.description: The abstract-syntax metaclass this concept lowers to (TTL vocabulary class name).

authority.description: The vocabulary that declares the metaclass: KerML (base) or SysML (domain).

supertypes.description: Direct superclasses (rdfs:subClassOf) — the inheritance chain's first hop.

shacl_shape.description: The OSLC ResourceShape carrying this metaclass's property constraints, when one exists.

properties.description: Owned/reference properties with multiplicities and relationship endpoints, from the OSLC shape.

source_pointers.description: Repo-relative pointers into the pinned vocabulary + shapes TTLs.

kind.description: reference (an element endpoint), boolean, string, datetime, or any.

reference_type.description: For a reference property, the target element type (a relationship endpoint / referenced element type).

read_only.description: A read-only (derived-style) property per the OSLC shape.

clause.description: Clause number as it appears in the derived plaintext '## <clause> <title>' heading lines.

anchor.description: Deterministic kebab-cased clause title; stable across upstream line renumbering.

resolution.description: Citation precision: 'exact' when the cited clause is itself a heading; 'ancestor' when the fine sub-clause has no heading and was resolved to its deepest existing ancestor heading (precision loss made visible to consumers).

positiveIdList.description: Example IDs whose bucket segment must be 'positive'.

negativeIdList.description: Example IDs whose bucket segment must be 'negative'.

composedIdList.description: Example IDs whose bucket segment must be 'composed'.

irNode.description: One normalized grammar IR node. Recursive. See language-pack-design.md section 5.

item.description: Single child for optional / zero-or-more / one-or-more.

name.description: Target rule/terminal/type name for rule-ref / terminal-ref / cross-ref.

raw.description: Verbatim source fragment for an unknown node (never dropped).

reason.description: Why an unknown node could not be classified.

source_paths.description: Canonical repo-relative source paths; never developer-absolute.
